why: Both tick grids. Transposing a price bound and a unit bound produces a market that posts cleanly and cannot be traded in. It predates call auctions and carries none of their fields, so it is also what a market from an older server reads as: continuous, carrying, in cents and whole units.

source.constructed: both tick grids populated and a transposition visible. Live markets in a dev marketplace do not reliably carry all four bounds, and a capture that found a market without them would quietly weaken the case.
